$comment: CLIENT CONFIG — the only file (besides brand tokens and the content tree)
a new site edits. Charter §5. Filled with NEUTRAL PLACEHOLDER values for the
'Example Home Services' demo. Replace every value with the real client's facts.
GOLDEN RULE (charter §1): if a value is true for ONE client only, it lives
here — never hardcoded in an Engine file.
NEVER FABRICATE. `geo`, `rating`, and every *Confirmed flag default to
null/false, and the Engine omits the corresponding output entirely rather
than inventing it. A confirmed-false flag is a real answer; leaving it
unconfirmed is what keeps an unverified claim off the page.
OPEN VERIFY items a new site fills before launch (do not fabricate):
· site.domain (provisional example.com until the real domain is chosen).
· business.hoursSpec / hoursConfirmed.
· compliance.licenseNumber / licensedClaimAllowed (if the vertical is licensed).
· business.geo / rating (never fabricated).
· GHL endpoint + GTM id are Cloudflare secrets / build vars, not here.

business.name: Example Home Services
business.$comment_hours: Placeholder Mon–Fri 8–5; hoursConfirmed stays false until real hours are confirmed, so nothing claims confirmed hours in schema.
$comment_identity: Entity-identity fields for the business JSON-LD node. Each is OMITTED
from the schema when blank/null. `sameAs` cites the business's own
authoritative profiles (GBP, Facebook, BBB) so Google can reconcile this
site with a known entity. Empty until the real profiles land.

compliance.$comment_licensed: licensedClaimAllowed stays false until a real license # is confirmed. Flip both together for a licensed vertical.

claimGates.$comment: Per-client claim gates. Each defaults false; the Engine withholds the claim until confirmed. A preset adds vertical-specific gates as its lead-form assurances need them.

$comment: Legal-doc + TCPA/A2P posture. Every value is a per-client fact.
`effectiveDate` is a HARDCODED string, never a computed date.
smsConsentRequired has NO Engine default — the build throws if it is unset.
It is a real business decision: required = a lead implies SMS consent but
adds submit friction; optional = no friction but the CRM MUST filter on
sms_consent === 'yes' before any SMS action. Set here to false (optional).
legalReviewedBy stays null until counsel signs off — both legal pages show a
draft banner and core30-lint warns (publish gate) until then. Do not set it
to drop the banner without a real review.
a2pBrandRegistered gates turning SMS actions ON in the CRM.

site.$comment_domain: PROVISIONAL placeholder. Canonical <link>s, JSON-LD url, and the sitemap all derive from this. Set the real domain before launch (find/replace + sitemap regen).
site.$comment_leadTag: CRM tag applied to every lead from this site's single quote form. Per-client / per-vertical; read by functions/api/lead.js via the generated config.
site.$comment_timeZone: IANA zone for lead-summary local times. Anytown, CA → US Pacific.

$comment: EXPERIMENTAL feature gates (R2 item E2). Each feature ships DARK by
default: the flag is false → zero routes, zero schema, nothing added to the
sitemap, and none of its lint checks fire. A fresh clone therefore builds
byte-identical whether or not these keys are present.
supportingContent — the topic-cluster `supporting` archetype
(docs/supporting-content-archetype.md): informational spokes (cost guides,
comparisons, tax/ROI answers) that link UP to a money page. Turn it on only
when you have authored real spokes; the example spoke in src/content/
example.js is placeholder copy that proves the machinery builds.
supportingContentStability — 'experimental' (default) keeps the archetype's
SOFT lint checks (SC-3 spoke→money link, SC-5 goal-completion, SC-7
reciprocity) as WARN so a mid-experiment spoke never reds the build. Do NOT
flip this to 'stable' (which hardens them to ERROR) until the live
experiment on a downstream site proves lift — it is a separate later
decision, not something to inherit.

wordmark.$comment: Two-line lockup used by the starter chrome. line1 is the identity word; line2 the subline.

brand.$comment_footer: logoMark/footerBlurb/footerLegal/favicon each fall back to a sensible derived default when blank (see src/lib/site.js). primaryCta is the mobile bar's main button.
